answer_2.quote: Given the strong performance of LLMs-as-judges, we use GPT-4o as an automated evaluator via prompting.

answer_3.quote: We use GPT-4o as judge across five dimensions, with overall improvement (Imp.) showing the win rate difference and higher values indicating better plan quality.
methods: pairwise plan comparison using LLM judge

answer_4.quote: human rater evaluated the final configuration, judging whether the plan achieved the stated goal... We measured inter-rater reliability ... average agreement of 0.54 between three GPT-4o judgements and three human annotators.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters assessed plans using the same five criteria (Coverage, Ordering, Completeness, Image Groundedness, Overall) and provided judgments on plan quality.
